what: Central Texas Food Bank interactive Find Food Now map/search tool (pantries + mobile distributions, current schedules). Primary live source, but UI is a cross-origin iframe widget and could not be scraped programmatically in this session.
how_to_scrape: Needs a real browser with iframe access, or discovery of the underlying data API (likely a PantryNet/AccessFood-style vendor embed) via browser devtools network tab. Search by ZIP/address, filter type=Mobile, read result cards for date/time/address.

what: Monthly Mobile Pantry Calendar page; links to a downloadable PDF calendar (one per month, e.g. media/1080 = Nov 2025, media/1104 = Dec 2025) covering all 21 counties with day-by-day distribution sites, addresses index, and times.
how_to_scrape: Fetch the current month's PDF (find current media ID via site search or the resource-center page), extract text with pymupdf/pdftotext. The PDF has a calendar grid (site+time per day) and a separate address index by county at the end.

what: CTFB location page for Travis County Expo Center mobile pantry: 1st Thursday, 9:30-10:30 AM, 7311 Decker Ln, Austin TX 78724.
how_to_scrape: WebFetch or curl the /location/<slug> page; schedule/address usually in page body text.

what: CTFB location page for Nelson Field drive-thru mobile pantry: 3rd Thursday, 9:00-10:30 AM, 7105 Berkman Dr, Austin TX 78752.

CTFB news page listing Williamson County mobile pantry and fresh-food distribution sites and recurrence patterns (Murphy Park Pavilion 3rd Fri, Holy Temple Church 2nd/4th Thu, St. Margaret Mary Catholic Church 4th Sat, Zion Chapel Fresh Food for Families 3rd Wed). Addresses not given on page - had to be resolved separately via web search. SKIPPED (pass 2): Murphy Park Pavilion address resolved to '1600 Veterans Drive, Taylor, TX 76574' (taylortx.gov, Yelp) but the Census batch geocoder returned No_Match for both '1600 Veterans Drive' and '1600 Veterans Dr' variants - dropped rather than guess coordinates. Holy Temple Church: the only web match found (holytemplechurchtx.com, 4831 Sunnyvale St, Dallas TX) is a different church entirely, not the Williamson County CTFB site - dropped, unresolved.
how_to_scrape: WebFetch the page directly; cross-reference site names against county property/church directories or Google to get street addresses, then geocode. For Murphy Park Pavilion, try Williamson CAD parcel lookup or Nominatim/Google Geocoding API (Census batch failed to match the park address) to get real lat/lng. For Holy Temple Church, try Williamson County appraisal district or Facebook/Google Maps search combined with 'Round Rock' or 'Hutto' or 'food pantry' to disambiguate from the Dallas church of the same name.

what: SKIPPED (pass 2): attempted to find the live Sept/Oct/Nov 2026 Mobile Pantry Calendar PDF. Site is Drupal 8 (confirmed via X-Generator header), so the coordinator-suggested /wp-json/wp/v2/media?search= endpoint does not exist (returns Drupal 404). Brute-forced Drupal media IDs 1288-1408 (step 8) via HEAD/GET on /media/<id>/download, all returned 404 - the Nov2025(1080)/Dec2025(1104) increment pattern does not hold into 2026. how_to_scrape: Needs a live re-fetch of /mobilepantry or /agencies/resource-center (may surface a currently-linked PDF not yet found by brute force or search-engine indexing), or a Drupal sitemap.xml crawl for /media/*/download links, or the CTFB Facebook page for a posted calendar image.

what: Agency-facing resource center listing current downloadable calendars (regional delivery calendars by month, mobile pantry calendar link, referral lists).
how_to_scrape: WebFetch; look for the current month's 'Mobile Pantry Calendar' and 'Regional Delivery Calendar' PDF links, media IDs increment roughly monthly.

what: CTFB public events page - mostly fundraising/gala events (Whatanight, Austin Empty Bowl), not food-distribution events for recipients. Checked but out of scope for this slice.
how_to_scrape: WebFetch; filter out fundraiser/gala listings, keep only actual public food-distribution events if any appear.

what: Eventbrite Austin free food & drink events listing. Searched but results were dominated by paid festivals (Flavors of West Austin, food-fest events), not food-insecurity distributions.
how_to_scrape: Eventbrite has a public search API/JSON endpoints; would need a session-based fetch or their API key to reliably filter for 'food pantry'/'food distribution' category events.

what: News article on Austin restaurants/food banks helping during the Nov 2026 SNAP benefits pause; contains some one-off dated giveaways (e.g. Aci restaurant free granita Nov 1) but mostly ongoing offers without exact addresses - not included in events.json due to insufficient address/eligibility clarity.
